feeds.title: LandLord Blog
feeds.description: The LandLord Lens is a full-service real estate and property management company that serves investors through every stage of property investing. Their team expertly manages condo units, houses, and multiplex properties. Go through their blog that offers landlords insights, stories, and other articles on Toronto property management and real estate.

feeds.title: Toronto Realty Blog » Leasing/Renting
feeds.description: Wade through their blog and learn more tips, tricks, ideas, services, articles, and more. Toronto realty group has an unprecedented level of Toronto real estate market knowledge and works around the clock to ensure that your real estate transaction is smooth and successful.

feeds.title: RHB Magazine
feeds.description: Rental Housing Business Magazine is Canada's one-stop platform and national voice to the rental housing industry. It is the official publication of the Canadian Federation of Apartment Associations. As the sole national voice for Canada's private rental housing industry, represents the owners and managers of close to one million residential rental suites across Canada. Stay tuned to get the latest updates.

feeds.title: FrontLobby Blog
feeds.description: FrontLobby is a platform designed for landlords, property managers and renters. Their mission is to improve the rental industry for everyone. They are committed to establishing an environment where both housing providers and tenants benefit. Explore more from their blog to know about their services, articles, resources, benefits, pricing, and more.

feeds.title: Landlord Credit Bureau Blog
feeds.description: Landlord Credit Bureau was established in 2012 with the goal of enhancing the lives and businesses of landlords, property managers, and responsible renters. It is focused on providing landlords with the transparency they need while helping responsible tenants prosper. Have a look at their blog that contains articles, tips, services, reports, etc.

feeds.title: LandlordBC News
feeds.description: LandlordBC is the industry leader for the residential rental housing industry in British Columbia. Their goal is to help you and your rental housing company. It takes pleasure in professionalizing the rental housing business via education, assistance, and-most importantly-government advocacy, whether you own one rental unit or hundreds. Check their blog and learn more about their services, membership, articles, news, webinar series, training, education, and more.

feeds.title: Landlord Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Landlord Rescue is an established Property Management Company servicing the Greater Toronto Area. According to their knowledge, evictions and renters from hell can be prevented. They have over 20 years of full-time experience in this industry and the knowledge needed to manage properties effectively. Dive into their blog to learn about services, media, property management, evictions, and much more.

feeds.title: SKLA Blog
feeds.description: As the voice of Saskatchewan's landlords, they disseminate information, encourage best practices, and fight for a strong and resilient rental housing market. They are the top group of experts in the field and take pride in offering rental properties that are secure and of the highest caliber. They seek to maintain a rental housing sector that meets the interests of tenants, owners, and managers by promoting new methods, fighting for fair laws, and supporting their members. Check out their blog to know about services, events, news, membership, etc.

feeds.title: Landlord by Design Blog
feeds.description: Landlord by Design was started as a form of therapy, a way to share ideas about ways to invest in real estate and manage your real estate investments. They strive to bring you useful, reality based content to help you manage your properties. Read their blog and know more about their services, books, news, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Ontario Landlords Association
feeds.description: Ontario Landlords Association started as a group of small landlords who thought it was time to promote the best services available and network and help each other succeed beginning nearly 15 years ago. They urge all of their readers to participate in democratic processes and communicate with elected leaders. Check out their blog for news, services, education, and more.

feeds.title: LowestRates.ca » Renting
feeds.description: Read all the news, stories, and updates you need to know about their blog. LowestRates.ca is a Fintech company founded in 2012 and based in Toronto, Ont. They believe in helping people make smarter decisions with their money. The ability to evaluate insurance, credit cards, mortgages, and loans provided by the top financial institutions in North America using this free and impartial website helps customers save time and money.

feeds.title: liv.rent Blog » Landlords
feeds.description: Seek more information from their blog that have resources for Canadian landlords, covering topics like tenant screening, property management, rental advertising, and more. Liv.rent blog provides you latest news, renter features, landlord features, case-studies laws and reports.

feeds.title: Rentals Blog » Landlords
feeds.description: Take a walk through their blog and learn more tips, tricks, services, careers, articles, latest news, rent reports, etc. Rentals provides you thousands of apartments, houses, and condos for rent across Canada, that matches your choices and comfort.
